items.description: OpenAmika: MekaHime's AI companion Amika, open source. Live2D avatar, real-time voice, long-term memory, OpenRouter or Ollama brain.

items.name: tiny-voca
items.description: A 4.5M-parameter two-voice English text-to-speech model, trained from scratch

items.name: Lampline
items.description: Build AI phone agents on your own computer and test every change with an AI caller. Open source, runs free with no API keys, cents per call with your own keys. Imports Dialogflow CX.

items.description: Turkish voice design with VoxCPM2 on a 4 GB GPU: describe a voice, pick a variant, read text in 30 languages. Patched audio.cpp, local UI in 30 languages, 14 ready-made voices.

items.name: ZONOS3-Mini
items.description: compact zero-shot voice-cloning TTS with state-of-the-art performance, leading voice control, real-time on-device.

items.name: tinglongwu
items.description: Offline real-time speech translation for meetings and calls. Runs locally: no cloud, no recordings kept.

items.name: CapriCore
items.description: Capri — an AI desktop companion for Windows with local/API models, Hugging Face, optional voice, memory and permission-based desktop tools.

items.name: paper-reel
items.description: Claude Code skill: faceless 9:16 explainer reels in a cut-paper style. Voice-timed scenes, word-by-word captions. Free, local, no API keys.

items.name: indextts2-longform-workbench
items.description: 基于 IndexTTS2.0 超级优化整合包 V3 的长篇台本工作台与多轨时间轴扩展：台本整理、批量 AI 配音、音效编排、空间音频、自动化混音与专业工程导出。仅含工作台代码。

items.name: pivis-video-dubbing-agent-kit
items.description: Agent-ready video dubbing toolkit for Apple Silicon: local Chinese speech and bilingual subtitles. Single-speaker preview; human review required.
